panels.title: Drives Online
panels.description: This metric is expected in a healthy system. 'No data' indicates missing instrumentation or scrape failure.

panels.title: Drives Offline
panels.description: This metric is event-driven and indicates drive offline events. 'No data' indicates no offline events observed in the selected time range.

panels.title: S3 Requests/sec
panels.description: This metric is expected in a healthy system. 'No data' indicates missing instrumentation or scrape failure.

panels.title: p95 Latency
panels.description: This metric is expected under normal traffic. 'No data' indicates no requests or missing instrumentation.

panels.title: Read/Write IOPS
panels.description: This metric is expected in a healthy system. 'No data' indicates missing instrumentation or scrape failure.

panels.title: Access Denied & Auth Failures
panels.description: This metric is event-driven and is only emitted on access/auth failures. 'No data' indicates no failures observed in the selected time range.

panels.title: Expirations & Version Cleanup
panels.description: This metric is event-driven and is only emitted on lifecycle / expiration events. 'No data' indicates no lifecycle events observed in the selected time range.

panels.title: High Latency Requests
panels.description: This metric is expected under normal traffic. 'No data' indicates no requests or missing instrumentation.
